description: This file defines the ProductAttribute class, which represents a product attribute in the system. It extends the Entity class and implements Serializable, containing references to ProductOption and ProductOptionValue objects with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: ProductAttribute
classes.description: Represents a product attribute with associated option and option value, serializable and extending Entity.

methods.name: setOptionValue
methods.description: Sets the ProductOptionValue associated with this attribute.

methods.name: getOptionValue
methods.description: Returns the ProductOptionValue associated with this attribute.

methods.name: setOption
methods.description: Sets the ProductOption associated with this attribute.

methods.name: getOption
methods.description: Returns the ProductOption associated with this attribute.
